metadata.overview: Controls Proto R2 Rig bitcoin miners over the public firmware MDK HTTP API v1 with JWT bearer authentication. Operations affect physical hardware—prioritize thermal and power safety.

telemetry.name: hashrate_avg
telemetry.description: Average miner hashrate reported by the current telemetry endpoint.

telemetry.name: efficiency
telemetry.description: Current miner energy efficiency. Firmware reports the equivalent J/TH value.

telemetry.name: status
telemetry.description: Mining state normalized to Tether MDK status values.

telemetry.name: uptime
telemetry.description: Elapsed time since system reboot in milliseconds.

telemetry.name: accepted_shares
telemetry.description: Total accepted shares across configured pools.

telemetry.name: rejected_shares
telemetry.description: Total rejected shares across configured pools.

telemetry.name: power_mode
telemetry.description: Current Tether MDK power mode: normal while operating and sleep while stopped or curtailed.

telemetry.name: power_target
telemetry.description: Configured mining power target in watts.

telemetry.name: fan_speed
telemetry.description: Average speed of all cooling fans.

telemetry.name: snap
telemetry.description: Structured miner statistics and non-secret configuration metadata.

telemetry.name: health
telemetry.description: Credential-safe device health: OK normally, DEGRADED for active firmware errors, or OFFLINE when status cannot be read.

commands.name: reboot
commands.constraints: Do not call more than once per 5 minutes. Do not retry after an unknown network outcome.

commands.name: setPowerMode
commands.constraints: Use normal to start mining or sleep to stop mining. Do not retry after an unknown network outcome.

commands.name: setPowerTarget
commands.description: Sets the R2 Rig mining power target in watts.
commands.constraints: Use a value within the device-reported minimum and maximum bounds. Verify cooling before increasing power. Do not retry after an unknown network outcome.

commands.name: setLED
commands.description: Turns the control-board locate LED on or off.
commands.constraints: Use only for physical identification. Do not retry after an unknown network outcome.

commands.name: setupPools
commands.description: Replaces the configured mining pools with one to three entries.
commands.constraints: The pools parameter must be an array containing one to three entries. Preserve the previous configuration before changing mining destinations. Do not retry after an unknown network outcome.

troubleshooting: If temperature is excessive, verify fan operation and ambient temperature before increasing the power target.
If status is error, inspect the firmware error source and slot before rebooting.
If status is offline, verify the address, password, HTTP port, and API reachability.

errors.ERR_DEVICE_ID_REQUIRED: The Tether MDK device ID is missing.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_ADDRESS_INVALID: The device address must be a non-empty host-only string without userinfo, a port, path, query, or fragment.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED: The device password or access token is missing.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_CREDENTIALS_INVALID: Configured password and token values must be non-empty strings.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_PORT_INVALID: The device port must be an integer from 1 through 65535.
errors.ERR_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED: The configured protocol must be HTTP or HTTPS.
errors.ERR_FETCH_REQUIRED: No HTTP fetch implementation is available.
errors.ERR_HTTP_CLIENT_REQUIRED: The API adapter needs an HTTP client.
errors.ERR_API_CLIENT_REQUIRED: The worker-facing client needs an API adapter.
errors.ERR_CACHE_DURATION_INVALID: The read cache duration must be a finite number from zero through 5000 milliseconds.
errors.ERR_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_INVALID: The request timeout must be an integer from 1 through 2147483647 milliseconds.
errors.ERR_REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The firmware request exceeded the configured timeout.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_CONNECTION: The worker could not connect to the firmware API. A write may have an unknown physical outcome.
errors.ERR_HTTP_RESPONSE: The firmware returned a non-success HTTP status. A write may have an unknown physical outcome.
errors.ERR_RESPONSE_INVALID_JSON: The firmware returned malformed JSON. A write may have an unknown physical outcome.
errors.ERR_AUTHENTICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID: The authentication response did not contain valid token strings.
errors.ERR_SYSTEM_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware system response was malformed.
errors.ERR_NETWORK_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware network response was malformed.
errors.ERR_MINING_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware mining response was malformed.
errors.ERR_POWER_TARGET_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware power-target response or safety bounds were malformed or unsafe.
errors.ERR_TELEMETRY_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware telemetry response was malformed.
errors.ERR_COOLING_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware cooling response was malformed.
errors.ERR_ERRORS_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware errors response was malformed.
errors.ERR_POOLS_RESPONSE_INVALID: The firmware pools response was malformed or contained an unsafe URL.
errors.ERR_POWER_TARGET_INVALID: The power target must normalize to a positive safe integer.
errors.ERR_POWER_TARGET_OUT_OF_RANGE: The power target is outside the bounds reported by the device.
errors.ERR_SET_POWER_MODE_INVALID: The power mode must be normal or sleep.
errors.ERR_SET_LED_ENABLED_INVALID: The LED value must be boolean.
errors.ERR_POOLS_INVALID: Pool configuration must contain one to three entries.
errors.ERR_POOL_ENTRY_INVALID: Each pool needs a safe URL without userinfo, a worker name, and valid optional strings.
errors.ERR_APPEND_ID_INVALID: The appendId pool option must be boolean.
